desc:
Step into a gritty dystopian world, and live out your cyberpunk dreams in this remaster of the original Neon District. Featuring a completely remade map and modern roleplay features. 🖥️

Update:
- 🏢 2 new apartments, "Old World Apartments" and "Beggars Cove Cisterns"
- 🍗 Cook different dystopian recipes at your home or at establishments throughout the map
- 🛋️ Updated prop placement system for more complex builds

⚙️ Please note: The game is still in active development — expect new locations, tools, episodes, and features to roll out over time. Some areas are still being refined and may change in future updates.
